providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Configure upstream channels and credential pools.
providers.empty: No providers yet. Add one to route traffic upstream.

settings.description: Edit the provider's typed endpoint, channel, and advanced settings.

form.channelHint: Channels come from this running GPROXY binary.
form.labelHint: Optional display text. The provider name remains the stable routing identifier.
form.credentialStrategyHint: Round robin rotates requests; sticky keeps each API key on a stable credential.
form.proxyHint: Overrides the instance proxy for this provider. Credentials can override it again.
form.settingsHint: Advanced JSON escape hatch. Declared fields above remain the normal editing path.
form.createError: Could not create the provider. Check the fields and retry.
form.updateError: Could not update the provider. Retry.

fingerprint.title: Client fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Override the channel's default headers and transport profile.
fingerprint.hint: Configured fingerprints fail loudly when no usable emulation can be built.
fingerprint.presetError: Could not load fingerprint presets. Retry.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.empty: No credentials yet. Add one before enabling traffic.
credentials.label: Credential label
credentials.kindHint: Records how this credential was obtained for listing and refresh behavior.
credentials.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
credentials.secretRequired: Enter at least one credential field.
credentials.createError: Could not add the credential. Check the secret and retry.
credentials.updateError: Could not update the credential. Retry.

endpoints.title: Endpoint overrides
endpoints.hint: Override only operations that must use a different absolute URL.

login.labelHint: Optional. Use a label that identifies the upstream account.
login.callbackHint: After authorizing, paste the full URL from the browser address bar here.
login.cookieHint: Paste the session cookie. It is sent once and never returned by the API.

errors.startDescription: The provider rejected the start step. Check the provider settings and retry.
errors.completeDescription: The code exchange failed. Check the redirected URL and retry this step.
errors.pollDescription: The provider status check failed. Retry without starting over.

errors.cookieDescription: The provider rejected the cookie. Check it and retry this step.
